name: The Immortal Soul
overview: Scripture reveals that man was formed from the dust and given life by God's breath, becoming a living soul (Genesis 2:7). However, death is certain for all, as the soul that sins shall die and the body returns to dust (Ezekiel 18:4; Genesis 3:19). The dead are described as knowing nothing and having no reward, emphasizing the cessation of consciousness at death (Ecclesiastes 9:5). Ultimately, the spirit returns to God who gave it, highlighting the dependence of life on God rather than an inherent immortal soul (Ecclesiastes 12:7).
